description: The names a rule's `triggers` may use, and that the event, budget and year-plan test sets use. A name can appear in more than one group (for example `food` is both an event attribute and a budget category). The loader rejects a rule that uses a name not listed here.

event_attributes.venue_tes_meeting_room: A Ronald Tutor Campus Center (TCC) meeting room, booked through Trojan Event Services
event_attributes.venue_tes_large: Bovard Auditorium, the Trojan Grand Ballroom, Tommy's Place or Traditions, booked through Trojan Event Services
event_attributes.venue_outdoor: An outdoor campus venue (parks, plazas, quads), booked through Trojan Event Services
event_attributes.venue_classroom: A classroom, booked through Classroom Scheduling
event_attributes.amplified_sound: Amplified sound: microphones, speakers, a DJ, instruments
event_attributes.tent: A tent, canopy or membrane structure
event_attributes.open_flame: Open flame, candles or canned heat (Sterno)
event_attributes.props: Props that need a safety review
event_attributes.av_equipment: Audio-visual equipment from Trojan Event Services
event_attributes.outside_rentals: Rented equipment from outside vendors: staging, tents, dance floor, audio-visual
event_attributes.tables_chairs: Tables and chairs requested from Facilities Management Services
event_attributes.social_event: A social event: party, mixer, culture night, banquet
event_attributes.ticket_sales: Tickets sold or an entry charge
event_attributes.cash_collection: Cash or payments collected at the event
event_attributes.charity_collection: Collecting money or goods for a charity or non-profit
event_attributes.co_hosts: Co-hosted or co-sponsored with another organization
event_attributes.outside_vendors: Outside businesses selling, exhibiting or promoting at the event (not a caterer or rental company the club hires)
event_attributes.performers: Performers, DJs, speakers or exhibitors from outside the club
event_attributes.travel: Travel: airfare, ground transport or an overnight hotel
event_attributes.recording: The event is filmed or recorded
event_attributes.high_risk_activity: A medium- or high-risk activity: swimming, contact sports, races, inflatables
event_attributes.dignitaries: Political leaders, dignitaries or celebrities attending
event_attributes.outside_guests_parking: Guests coming to campus for the event who will need parking
event_attributes.tabling: A walk-up information table on Trousdale Parkway or Gavin Herbert Plaza
event_attributes.multi_day: The event runs over more than one day
event_attributes.not_open_to_all_students: An on-campus event not open to all students

line_item_categories.food: Food and non-alcoholic drinks from a caterer or vendor
line_item_categories.raw_food: Raw food that needs refrigeration or preparation
line_item_categories.personnel: On-campus staffing (production, custodial, security staff billed by the university)
line_item_categories.promotional_items: Promotional goods that build the club's brand (banners, stickers)
line_item_categories.durable_goods: Items not for one-time use: electronics, uniforms, equipment
line_item_categories.performer_fee: Payment to talent or performers (DJ, band, dancers, speakers' fees)
line_item_categories.ground_transport: Ground transport such as a chartered coach
line_item_categories.rideshare: Rideshare, buses, vans, Amtrak cabins, car rentals
line_item_categories.peer_to_peer: Payments through Airbnb, VRBO, PayPal, Zelle, CashApp or similar
line_item_categories.charity_donation: A payment or donation to a charity
line_item_categories.reimbursement: Paying someone back for something they bought
line_item_categories.other: Anything else; always needs a human look

application_facts.usg_funding: The club is asking USG for funding
application_facts.conference_registration: Registration for a conference or event that has a login
application_facts.new_club: The club was first registered with Campus Activities within the last two academic semesters
